tanzzz.objective: Launch Tanzzz with high-converting product photography and video assets for Amazon, Shopify, and social.
tanzzz.timeline: 2-5 weeks depending on selected package and final product delivery
tanzzz.summary: Tanzzz solves a real problem spray tan users know too well: waiting hours for a tan to develop while it stains sheets, rubs off on clothes, and leaves a mess behind. This proposal is built to turn the product from just another jumpsuit into a clearly differentiated product with visuals that show exactly why it matters.
tanzzz.tier1desc: Core product photography for Amazon and Shopify plus a basic product handling video for launch-ready storefront visuals.
tanzzz.tier2desc: Everything in Tier 1 plus lifestyle video and expanded product photography for a full multi-channel launch.
tanzzz.tier3desc: Everything in Tier 2 plus extended storytelling video, full product photography suite, and content variations for scale.

rise-rejuvenation-center.objective: Build an emotionally-driven transformation series that lowers fear, creates trust, and helps viewers feel what it is like to walk into Rise before they ever book.
rise-rejuvenation-center.timeline: 4-6 months for the $45,000 scope; 5-7 months for the $70,000 expanded scope
rise-rejuvenation-center.summary: This project is designed to make the Rise experience feel human, safe, and inspiring. Instead of asking prospects to imagine what treatment feels like, the audience follows three real model transformation journeys — the questions, the nerves, the service experience, the before-and-after confidence, and Traci’s mission behind why Rise does this work.
rise-rejuvenation-center.tierssubheading: Both options preserve the core emotional story. The $70,000 scope expands the launch engine, founder story, funnel strategy, and audience reach.
rise-rejuvenation-center.overviewSubtitle: Make beauty, injectables, and transformation feel less intimidating by letting people experience the journey first.
overviewParagraphs: The heart of this project is emotional connection. Viewers should feel like they already know what it is like to walk into Rise, ask questions, receive services, and move through a real transformation before they ever schedule their own visit.

The three model journeys create a live reality-show experience that lowers the barrier for women who are curious but nervous. They see the consultation, the vulnerability, the process, the results, and the confidence shift in real time.

Traci’s story gives the series its deeper meaning: this is not just aesthetic content. It is about helping women feel beautiful, confident, and seen because Rise has watched that confidence directly impact people’s lives.
rise-rejuvenation-center.comparisonSubheading: The first option captures the transformation journey. The expanded option turns it into a larger launch campaign with founder storytelling, conversion funnels, social CRM, PR, influencer opportunities, and a bigger reveal moment.

detailCards.label: EMOTIONAL CONNECTION
detailCards.title: Let prospects feel the experience before they book.
detailCards.body: The series answers the emotional questions that usually stop people from taking action: What will it feel like? What should I ask? Will I feel judged? Will the transformation be worth it? Seeing real women move through the process makes the decision safer.

detailCards.label: MISSION-DRIVEN POSITIONING
detailCards.title: Make Traci’s why part of the brand story.
detailCards.body: Traci’s story gives the campaign a reason to exist beyond content. It connects Rise’s work to confidence, identity, and the visible life impact of helping women feel beautiful again.
